game_concept: A survival strategy set in Shadow Cave – Collapsed Passage, a half-collapsed passage: the lantern keeper must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Continue Gate: Use continue to skip spoiled lantern oil but keep the loop running.
theme: Shadow Cave – Collapsed Passage: a half-collapsed passage
core_gameplay_loop: In Collapsed Passage, repeat each round: Use continue to skip spoiled lantern oil but keep the loop running. Each round, glow-eyed lurkers strike the lantern post, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the skipped_ok value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the lantern post from glow-eyed lurkers in Collapsed Passage: keep the skipped_ok meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 30-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: skipped_ok drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 30-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Continue Gate
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how skipped_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against glow-eyed lurkers in Collapsed Passage.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 30 seconds while skipped_ok > 0.
